an4.244:1.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ--ayaṃ
an4.244:1.7: gacchatha bho imaṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchā bāhaṃ gāḷha bandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindathāti.
an4.244:1.8: Tam enaṃ rañño purisā daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchā bāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindeyyuṃ.
an4.244:1.9: Tatr' aññatarassa thalaṭṭhassa purisassa evam assa:
an4.244:1.10: pāpakaṃ vata bho ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ akāsi gārayhaṃ sīsacchejjaṃ,
an4.244:1.11: yatra hi nāma rañño purisā daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchā bāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bhanditvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindissanti.
an4.244:1.12: So vat' assāhaṃ evarūpaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ na kareyyaṃ gārayhaṃ sīsacchejjan ti. Evam
an4.244:1.13: eva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā evaṃ tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti pārājikesu dhammesu
an4.244:1.14: tass' etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ --anāpanno vā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ na āpajjissati āpanno vā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ yathādhammaṃ paṭikarissati. 2.
an4.244:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā musalaṃ khandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya:
an4.244:2.2: ahaṃ bhante pāpaṃ kammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ mosallaṃ, yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomīti.
an4.244:2.3: Tatr' aññatarassa thalaṭṭhassa purisassa evam assa:
an4.244:2.4: pāpakaṃ vata bho ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ akāsi gārayhaṃ mosallaṃ,
an4.244:2.5: yatra hi nāma kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā musalaṃ khandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vakkhati:
an4.244:2.6: aham bhante pāpaṃ kammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ mosallaṃ, yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomīti.
an4.244:2.7: So vat' assāhaṃ evarūpaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ na kareyyaṃ gārayhaṃ mosallan ti. Evam
an4.244:2.8: eva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā evaṃ tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti saṅghādisesesu dhammesu tass' etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ--anāpanno vā saṅghādisesaṃ dhammaṃ na āpajjissati āpanno vā saṅghādisesaṃ dhammaṃ yathādhammaṃ paṭikarissati. 3.
an4.244:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā assapuṭaṃ khandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya:
an4.244:3.2: ahaṃ bhante pāpaṃ kammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ assapuṭaṃ,
an4.244:3.3: yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomīti.
an4.244:3.4: Tatr' aññatarassa thalaṭṭhassa purisassa evam assa:
an4.244:3.5: pāpakaṃ vata bho ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ akāsi gārayhaṃ assapuṭaṃ,
an4.244:3.6: yatra hi nāma kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā assapuṭaṃ kandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vakkhati:
an4.244:3.7: ahaṃ bhante pāpaṃ kammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ assapuṭaṃ,
an4.244:3.8: yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomīti.
an4.244:3.9: So vat' assāham evarūpaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ na kareyyaṃ gārayhaṃ assapuṭan ti.
an4.244:3.10: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā evaṃ tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti pācittiyesu dhammesu tass' etaṃ pātikaṅkhaṃ--anāpanno vā pācittiyaṃ dhammaṃ na āpajjissati āpanno vā pācittiyaṃ dhammaṃ yathādhammaṃ paṭikarissati. 4.
an4.244:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya:
an4.244:4.2: ahaṃ bhante pāpaṃ kammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ upavajjaṃ,
an4.244:4.3: yena me āyasmanto attamanā hoti taṃ karomīti.
an4.244:4.4: Tatr' aññatarassa thalaṭṭhassa purisassa evam assa:
an4.244:4.5: pāpakaṃ vata bho ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ akāsi gārayhaṃ upavajjaṃ
an4.244:4.6: yatra hi nāma kāḷakam vatthaṃ panidhāya kese pakiritvā . . . mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vakkhati:
an4.244:4.8: yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomīti.
an4.244:4.9: So vat' assāhaṃ evarūpaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ na kareyyaṃ gārayhaṃ upavajjan ti. Evam
an4.244:4.10: eva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhussa va bhikkhuniyā vā evaṃ tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti pātidesanīyakesu dhammesu, tass' etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ --anāpanno vā pāṭidesanīyakaṃ dhammaṃ na āpajjissati āpanno vā pāṭidesanīyakaṃ dhammaṃ yathādhammaṃ paṭikarissati.
